solutionSql:
SELECT s.id
FROM shipments AS s
WHERE s.status = 'queued'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM shipment_events AS e
    WHERE e.shipment_id = s.id
  )
ORDER BY s.id;
notes: Anti-join with NOT EXISTS, filtered to status = 'queued' (the sample's only spelling of queued; other statuses are cancelled, delivered, in_transit). NOT EXISTS avoids the NOT IN NULL trap, though shipment_events.shipment_id is NOT NULL anyway. Sample returns ids 1, 56, 100, 122.
